mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM CHANGE_ID,T.* FROM ( SELECT CHANGE_PROJECT, CHANGE_WAY, CHANGE_DESC, UPDATETIME FROM ( SELECT '1' AS CHANGE_PROJECT, DECODE(CHANNELCODE,'DIR','柜台','NET','电商') AS CHANGE_WAY, DECODE(OLD_INVPRTP,'0','专业投资者转','1','普通投资者转') || DECODE(INVPRTP,'0','专业投资者','1','普通投资者') AS CHANGE_DESC, EVALDATE AS UPDATETIME FROM H_CUSTINVPRTP WHERE CUSTNO = #{sp.custNo} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CHANGE_PROJECT, DECODE(CHANNELCODE,'DIR','柜台','NET','电商') AS CHANGE_WAY, DECODE(IBF_GET_PARAMNAME('SYSTEM','CUSTRISKLEVEL',RISKLEVEL),'','C0-最低', IBF_GET_PARAMNAME('SYSTEM','CUSTRISKLEVEL',RISKLEVEL)) CHANGE_DESC, UPDATETIME FROM ( SELECT '0' AS CHANGE_PROJECT, CHANNELCODE, RISKLEVEL, TO_DATE(EVALDATE || EVALTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UPDATETIME FROM H_CUSTRISKLEVEL HC WHERE HC.CUSTNO = #{sp.custNo} UNION ALL SELECT '0' AS CHANGE_PROJECT, CHANNELCODE, DECODE((SELECT C1.SPECRISKLEVEL FROM CUSTINFO C1 WHERE CUSTNO = #{sp.custNo} ),'1','0',RISKLEVEL)RISKLEVEL, TO_DATE(EVALDATE || EVALTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UPDATETIME FROM CUSTRISKLEVEL C WHERE C.CUSTNO = #{sp.custNo})ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC)) T
